description: Step-by-step magnitudes and coherence lower bounds of the neglected processes for the cat-code cycle at the parameters of Ofek et al. under the full noise model, no decoherence, and single decoherence mechanisms.

toy_checks.description: Diamond-norm magnitudes and power-law fits for few-level toy steps with a jump of probability p and an optional rotation by angle theta.

rotation_after_jump_from_error_space_onl.rotation: exp(-i theta (|e1><l1| + h.c.)/2), after the jump only
